text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Debut race. Student Council 
President Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky 
came together to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
High expectations and attention are 
already focused on Mr. C.B.'s success. 
However, she doesn't let any of it bother 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's debut was set for a year 
later. Mr. C.B. offered a handshake, 
asking to race her when the time came, 
before happily heading off to her own 
contest.
